# Japan Trip Tools

Japan Trip Tools is an independent English-language Japan travel planning site with practical guides, regional hubs, and browser-based travel tools.

Sitemap: https://japantriptools.com/sitemap.xml
Home: https://japantriptools.com
Articles: https://japantriptools.com/articles/
Regions: https://japantriptools.com/regions/
Tools: https://japantriptools.com/tools/
Image credits: https://japantriptools.com/image-credits/

Important tools:
- Trip planner: https://japantriptools.com/tools/trip-planner/
- JR Pass checker: https://japantriptools.com/tools/jr-pass-calculator/
- Airport transfer planner: https://japantriptools.com/tools/airport-transfer/
- Budget calculator: https://japantriptools.com/tools/budget-calculator/
- Luggage planner: https://japantriptools.com/tools/luggage-planner/

Editorial note: pages are written in original professional English for international travelers. Readers should verify current prices, schedules, closures, safety alerts, and booking rules with official providers before travel.
